About College
Tengakhat College is situated in Tengakhat about 30 K.M. east of Dibrugarh Town and 17 K.M.
                    West of Duliajan Oil Town. The college was established in 1967 at the initiative of a few
                    eminent educationists and social workers of Tengakhat.
Read More
From Principal's desk
Prof. Jatindranath Gogoi
This College is one of the leading institutions of the district that has achieved maximum academic excellence in a period of four decades since its establishment. We have a beautiful architectural campus which has a fascinating, peaceful and pollution free environment.
